source: Companies House public register, read page by page at find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk on 06/08/2026. MANUAL INTERIM: the Companies House API key is still awaited, so these records were read from the public website by hand, one company at a time, for the example lot only. scripts/refresh_companies_house.py replaces this file wholesale once COMPANIES_HOUSE_KEY exists — nothing here is load-bearing beyond the companies it names.
coverage: The suppliers on GBUK Group's two frameworks only (NHS Supply Chain IV Cannula; Needle-free Connection Systems). 8 companies of the 459 in supplier-index.json. Every other supplier is ABSENT, not unresolved — a report for an absent company renders the Stage 3 panel's honest empty state.
accountsCategoryNote: accountsCategory here is read from the exact wording of the company's most recent accounts filing on the public register ('Full accounts made up to ...' -> full; 'Group of companies' accounts ...' -> group). The Companies House API returns a 17-value enum instead; mapping that enum to this file's vocabulary is an open design point for refresh_companies_house.py, recorded in docs/COMPANY-REPORT-METHOD.md. Do not widen verify.py's list to make an unmapped value pass.

thresholds.appliesTo: in relation to a financial year beginning on or after 6th April 2025 (SI 2024/1303 reg 3, quoted verbatim)

micro.verbatim: Your company will be a micro-entity if it has any 2 of the following: a turnover of £1 million or less, £500,000 or less on its balance sheet, 10 employees or less

small.verbatim: Your company will be 'small' if it has any 2 of the following: a turnover of £15 million or less, £7.5 million or less on its balance sheet, 50 employees or less

medium.verbatim: Turnover: Not more than £54 million. Balance sheet total: Not more than £27 million. Number of employees: Not more than 250.
medium.verbatimSource: https://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/2006/46/section/465 (s465(3) as amended by SI 2024/1303 reg 10: turnover row 'for Not more than £36 million substitute Not more than £54 million'; balance sheet row 'for Not more than £18 million substitute Not more than £27 million')

Nipro Medical Europe.matchedOn: The NHSSC catalogue names this supplier NIPRO EUROPE NV UK — a Belgian NV trading through a UK arm. Its UK branch registrations (BR008139; FC025899, 'Refer To Parent Registry, Belgium') are both CLOSED on the register, and while active UK Nipro companies exist (NIPRO MEDICAL UK LTD 06993337, Southampton; NIPRO LIMITED 03054349; NIPRO DIAGNOSTICS (UK) LIMITED 03936551), none is confirmed as the framework supplier. No UK statutory accounts category can be attached to this supplier — a company that files in Belgium has no Companies House size band, and inventing one from a sister company would attach the wrong company's finances to the name.
